contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban shopping streets with small tiled building walls, cafe and florist shopfronts, canvas awnings, utility pipes and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

title.de: Mit einem Paket an der Tür

deck.ko: 샌드 코트 사이로 이어지는 회색과 네이비.
deck.en: Gray and navy run between open sand coat panels.
deck.de: Grau und Marine zwischen offenen sandfarbenen Mantelseiten.

intro.ko: 작은 상자를 골반에 받친 채 빈손으로 문고리를 잡습니다.
intro.en: A small parcel is steadied at the hip while the free hand reaches for the door.
intro.de: Das kleine Paket liegt an der Hüfte, während die freie Hand die Türklinke greift.

body.ko: 가벼운 샌드 코트의 열린 앞면 사이로 회색 니트와 네이비 와이드 팬츠가 이어집니다. 흰 로톱은 어두운 바지 아래 밝은 끝점을 만들고 갈색 크로스백은 몸 옆에 놓입니다. 옆으로 돌아선 자세와 직광 플래시는 코트 소매와 바지의 넓은 폭을 함께 보여줍니다. 상자는 상황을 설명하는 소품이며 착장 제품과 구분됩니다.
body.en: A light sand coat opens over gray knit and navy wide trousers. White low-tops make a bright finish under dark hems, with a brown crossbody resting at the side. The sideward turn and direct flash reveal the coat sleeve and broad trouser shape together. The box explains the incident and remains a scene prop rather than an outfit product.
body.de: Der leichte sandfarbene Mantel öffnet sich über grauem Strick und weiter marineblauer Hose. Weiße Halbschuhe setzen einen hellen Abschluss unter dunkle Säume, die braune Tasche liegt seitlich. Seitliche Drehung und direkter Blitz zeigen Mantelärmel und weite Hosenform zugleich. Die Schachtel erklärt die Situation und bleibt eine Szenenrequisite.

pull.en: A quiet vertical line inside the open coat.
pull.de: Eine ruhige vertikale Linie im offenen Mantel.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A quiet vertical line inside the open coat.

tip.ko: 계단을 넘기 전 긴 바지 밑단을 확인하고 가방이 문 여는 팔을 막지 않게 옮기세요.
tip.en: Check long hems at the step and move the bag clear of the arm opening the door.
tip.de: An der Stufe die langen Säume prüfen und die Tasche vom türöffnenden Arm wegschieben.

description.ko: 작은 칼라와 어두운 단추, 커프 탭, 무릎 길이의 샌드 코트입니다.
description.en: Sand knee-length coat with collar, dark buttons and cuff tabs.
description.de: Knielanger sandfarbener Mantel mit Kragen, dunklen Knöpfen und Ärmelriegeln.

howToWear.ko: 앞을 열어 회색 니트와 네이비 바지의 세로선을 보여 주세요.
howToWear.en: Wear open to show the vertical gray-and-navy line beneath.
howToWear.de: Offen tragen und die vertikale Grau-Marine-Linie darunter zeigen.
